# Package `agent`

Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/agent` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/agent) · Stability: **core**

Package agent is the core of bide, a Go framework for AI agents that move money: a durability-first, Go-idiomatic toolkit whose side effects fire at most once, whose approvals are signed and counted by k-of-n, and whose every action is provable afterwards.

**Constants**

- `const MaxDecisionCertChain = 8`, `const MaxDecisionCertDER = 16 << 10`: MaxDecisionCertChain and MaxDecisionCertDER bound the certificate chain a decision carries: at most this many certificates, each at most this many bytes of DER.
- `const ReasonNotEligible = "not an eligible approver"`, `const ReasonSuperseded`, `const ReasonNoKey = "no key for this approver"`, `const ReasonBadSig`, `const ReasonSharedKey`, `const ReasonNoKeyID`, `const ReasonAlg`, `const ReasonNoDecidedAt`, `const ReasonDecidedAt`, `const ReasonRequester`, `const ReasonNoRequester`, `const ReasonLate`: Reasons a decision record does not count.
- `const ReasonAfterExpiry`: ReasonAfterExpiry: the decision's write landed after the gate recorded its expiry, even if it was stamped before the deadline.
- `const ReasonNoCert`, `const ReasonCertChain`, `const ReasonCertIdentity`, `const ReasonCertUsage`, `const ReasonCertWindow`: Reasons a certificate-bound approver's decision does not count (docs/design/approver-identity.md).
- `const ReasonRevoked`: ReasonRevoked: a certificate of the chain has an effective revocation time at or before A(d).
- `const ReasonStatusUnknown`: ReasonStatusUnknown: no usable status covers a certificate of the chain.
- `const ReasonStatusStale`: ReasonStatusStale: the status available is past nextUpdate or older than the policy allows.
- `const ReasonNoCoveringHead`: ReasonNoCoveringHead: no signed tree head of the run covers the decision yet, so the time it became provable is not known.
- `const ReasonHeadTimes`: ReasonHeadTimes: the head that first covers the decision is implicated in a contradiction among the run's head times (a larger head stamped earlier than a smaller one, beyond the tolerance).
- `const ApprovalIdentityFormat = "bide.approval-identity.v2"`, `const ApprovalStatusFormat = "bide.approval-status.v2"`, `const ApprovalExecHoldFormat = "bide.approval-exec-hold.v2"`, `const ApprovalIdentityRulesVer = "v1"`: Formats of the identity records.
- `const EvaluatedLive = "live"`: EvaluatedLive is ApprovalIdentity.Evaluated of a record the live gate wrote.
- `const MaxStatusInline = 256 << 10`: MaxStatusInline is the largest status record (a CRL's DER) stored in the journal; above it the record holds the metadata and the hash, and the bytes go to the policy's status archive.
- `const PauseAwaitingDecisions = "awaiting-decisions"`, `const PauseAwaitingAnchor = "awaiting-anchor"`, `const PauseAwaitingStatus = "awaiting-status"`, `const PauseHeldUntilFinal = "held-until-final"`, `const PauseExecHold = "exec-hold"`: Pause phases (ApprovalWait.Pause): why a gate with a certificate-bound approver is waiting.
- `const TierIndependentFinal = "independent-final"`, `const TierLogclockFinal = "logclock-final"`, `const TierProvisional = "provisional"`: Identity tiers (IdentityDecision.Tier).
- `const BasisAtOrAfterDecision = "at-or-after-decision"`, `const BasisLiveBeforeDecision = "live-before-decision"`: Status bases (IdentityDecision.BasisKind).
- `const TimeSourceLogSignerClock = "log-signer-clock"`, `const TimeSourceRFC3161 = "rfc3161"`, `const TimeSourceAnchorReceipt = "anchor-receipt"`: Time sources (IdentityDecision.TimeSource).
- `const CompensationAllow = "allow"`, `const CompensationBlock = "block"`: Compensation says whether a stop also holds the compensation (the rollback) of the calls it covers.
- `const DecisionFormat = "bide.approval.v3"`: DecisionFormat names the signed decision format this version writes and accepts: the domain tag of ApprovalDecisionBytes without its newline.
- `const DecisionFormatCert = "bide.approval.v4"`: DecisionFormatCert names the signed decision format of a certificate-bound approver: the v3 layout plus the SHA-256 of the signer's leaf certificate (ApprovalDecisionBytesCert).
- `const DefaultReceiver = "default"`: DefaultReceiver is the name of the receiver WithNotifier's Notifier is, in Notification.Receiver and in WithNotifyRoute, WithNotifyApproverRoute and EscalationStep.
- `const ExpiredResult`: ExpiredResult is the result an agent's model reads for a call whose approval gate expired: an error result, as for a denial.
- `const JournalFormat = "bide.journal.v1-dev"`: JournalFormat is the journal format this version writes: the format every run's header names (see StepHeader).
- `const MaxEscalationSteps = maxEscalationSteps`: MaxEscalationSteps is the most steps an escalation chain may have.
- `const MaxStopReason = 1024`: MaxStopReason bounds the reason of a stop, a lift or a mode change, in bytes.
- `const NotifyDigestTrail = "notify:@digest"`: NotifyDigestTrail is the name of the trail the periodic digest uses; it belongs to no run.
- `const NotifyOpenTrail = "notify:@open"`: NotifyOpenTrail is the prefix of the trail that lists the events whose all-clear may still be owed: a watch record before an outcome\_unknown, approval\_pending or recovery\_failing event is observed, an unwatch record when nothing more is owed for it.
- `const OpenFirstYear = 2026`: OpenFirstYear is the first year an open-trail index can exist: the year the open trail began.
- `const PendingExecHoldReapproval`: PendingExecHoldReapproval is ApprovalPending.Reason for a certificate-bound gate whose counted approvals were held before execution (ExecHold: a counted decision no longer holds): the call did not run, and it runs once approvers decide again and a new count passes (ApprovalIdentTallyStep of the next generation).
- `const PendingIdentReapproval`: PendingIdentReapproval is ApprovalPending.Reason for a certificate-bound gate whose recorded tally is a plain-name one (approval-tally:&lt;id&gt;), counted without the approvers' certificates: the gate does not run the call on it, and asks again; the new count is recorded under ApprovalIdentTallyStep.
- `const PendingIdentityStatus`: PendingIdentityStatus is ApprovalPending.Reason for a certificate-bound gate whose counted approvals cannot be shown to hold right now (the status of a certificate is missing or stale, or a decision no signed head covers): the call did not run and nothing authoritative was written.
- `const PendingReapproval`: PendingReapproval is ApprovalPending.Reason for a gate that passed under decisions signed before DecisionFormat (a run journaled by an earlier version): its call did not run, and it runs once approvers decide again under DecisionFormat with SubmitDecision.
- `const PendingSoDReapproval`: PendingSoDReapproval is ApprovalPending.Reason for a gate whose recorded tally passed without excluding the requester (ApprovalPolicy.ExcludePrincipal) while its policy now excludes it: the call did not run, and it runs once enough approvers who are not requesters have decided.
- `const ReanchorMinInterval = 10 * time.Second`: ReanchorMinInterval is the least time between two forced heads of one run: anchoring signs with the log key, which may be an HSM or KMS key with quotas and cost, so the gate rate-limits it.
- `const SaltSize = 32`: SaltSize is the length of Record.Salt: 32 bytes (256 bits) from crypto/rand.
- `const StopControlRun = "@stop"`: StopControlRun is the run ID of the control run: the journal run in which a store holds the stop, lift and mode records.
- `const StopFormat = "bide.stop/1"`: StopFormat names the format of a stop record.

**Variables**

- `var ErrConfig = errors.New("config")`: ErrConfig is a programmer-facing misuse or misconfiguration, not a runtime fault.
- `var ErrModel = errors.New("model")`: ErrModel is a model-provider call that failed: HTTP status, decode, stream error.
- `var ErrTool = errors.New("tool")`: ErrTool is a tool that failed or was misused (unknown tool, bad arguments).
- `var ErrStorage = errors.New("storage")`: ErrStorage is a durable-store I/O failure: marshal, insert, query, history.
- `var ErrProtocol = errors.New("protocol")`: ErrProtocol is malformed wire or journal data (bad log entry, unknown content part).
- `var ErrBudget = errors.New("budget")`: ErrBudget is a middleware limit tripping (e.g. a token budget).
- `var ErrUnknownTool = fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %w", ErrTool)`, `var ErrToolArgs`: Condition sentinels, specific causes, each wrapping its category.
- `var ErrToolOutcomeUnknown`: ErrToolOutcomeUnknown is a tool call that may or may not have taken effect: the tool sent its request but lost the connection (or its deadline passed) before the answer came back.
- `var ErrToolReinvoked`: ErrToolReinvoked is a tool middleware calling a tool that is not retry-safe a second time for the same tool call.
- `var ErrNoRecordedOutput`: Condition sentinels, specific causes, each wrapping its category.
- `var ErrIncompleteResponse`: ErrIncompleteResponse is a model stream that ended without a Finish event: the response stopped partway through a turn, so what arrived is not the model's answer.
- `var ErrTruncatedToolArgs`: Condition sentinels, specific causes, each wrapping its category.
- `var ErrOutputTruncated`: ErrOutputTruncated is a model turn that ended at its output token limit (or the context window): Finish reason FinishLength.
- `var ErrOutputFiltered`: ErrOutputFiltered is a model turn that a provider's safety or content filter stopped, or that the model refused: Finish reason FinishFiltered.
- `var ErrStreamProtocol`: ErrStreamProtocol is a model stream that broke its provider's event protocol, such as content after the turn's end or an event after the Finish.
- `var ErrToolUseIDReused`: ErrToolUseIDReused is a model turn whose tool call has no ID, repeats an ID from an earlier turn of the conversation, repeats one within the turn, or has an ID that is not valid UTF-8 (the journal cannot hold it).
- `var ErrNegativeUsage`: ErrNegativeUsage is token usage with a negative count, reported by a model or returned by a middleware.
- `var ErrQuotaExhausted`: ErrQuotaExhausted is a provider refusing a call because the account's quota or credit is used up (OpenAI insufficient\_quota, Anthropic billing\_error, HTTP 402, a Gemini daily quota), as opposed to a momentary rate limit.
- `var ErrResponseTooLarge`: ErrResponseTooLarge is a streamed response with a line longer than the adapter reads, or longer in all than its adapter's cap (see MaxSSELine and LimitResponse in model/provider).
- `var ErrBudgetExceeded`, `var ErrMaxTurns`: Condition sentinels, specific causes, each wrapping its category.
- `var ErrInvalidApproval`: ErrInvalidApproval is an approver decision rejected at submission by SubmitDecision's WithDecisionCheck: no such tool call, an unknown approver, or a signature that does not verify for this exact call.
- `var ErrStatusUnavailable`: ErrStatusUnavailable is a certificate-bound decision submitted (with WithDecisionCheck) while the revocation status of its chain is missing or stale: the decision is not refused, the gate cannot judge it yet, and nothing is written.
- `var ErrAlreadyDecided`: ErrAlreadyDecided is a decision submitted (with WithDecisionCheck) by an approver whose earlier valid decision on the same call already counts; the new one would be ignored.
- `var ErrRedactNotTerminal`: ErrRedactNotTerminal is a redaction in a run with no end marker.
- `var ErrRedactLeased`: ErrRedactLeased is a redaction in a run whose lease is live: a driver may be running it.
- `var ErrRedactProtected`: ErrRedactProtected is a redaction of a record a verifier or the engine needs (see RedactionProtected).
- `var ErrRedactMismatch`: ErrRedactMismatch is a tombstone whose leaf hash is not the leaf hash of the bytes it replaces, or one that is not a well-formed tombstone.
- `var ErrRedactSession`: ErrRedactSession is a redaction in a session's journal or turn run: the session reads its turns' runs and never ends, so a redaction there is refused.
- `var ErrRedactParentLive`: ErrRedactParentLive is a redaction in a sub-agent's run while a run above it is not over: the parent reads the child's records when it replays the call.
- `var ErrRedactChanged`: ErrRedactChanged is a redaction of an entry whose bytes are not the bytes the caller read: another writer changed it, or the caller's copy is not what is stored.
- `var ErrRedactNoEntry`: ErrRedactNoEntry is a redaction of an entry the run does not hold.
- `var ErrAlreadyResolved`: ErrAlreadyResolved is the condition of a resolution refused because the operation already has a different recorded outcome (see HaltAlreadyResolved).
- `var ErrApprovalExpired = errors.New("approval expired")`: ErrApprovalExpired is returned (wrapped) when an approval gate's deadline has passed: by Approve and SubmitDecision for a decision on such a gate (also ErrConfig: nothing is recorded), and by a plan flow for a node whose gate expired (also plan.ErrApprovalDenied).
- `var ErrGateNeedsNewRun = errors.New("the gate needs a new run")`: ErrGateNeedsNewRun is wrapped (with ErrConfig) by the error of a certificate-bound gate that cannot go on in place: its recorded count passed without excluding the requester and the policy now excludes them, so no re-ask can be named.
- `var ErrInvalidStop = errors.New("agent: invalid stop record")`: ErrInvalidStop marks a stop record that is malformed, or that no policy in force authorises.
- `var ErrJournalVersion`: ErrJournalVersion is a run whose journal this version cannot read or write: its header names a journal format this version does not support, or the journal has no header first (written before the header existed, or by something other than a Journal).
- `var ErrLeaseLost = errors.New("run lease lost")`: ErrLeaseLost ends a drive whose run lease was lost while it ran: the store reported the lease no longer held (it lapsed and another process took it), or no renewal succeeded before the renewal cutoff (see Lease).
- `var ErrNoLiveAttempt`: ErrNoLiveAttempt is the condition of a resolution refused because the operation named has no live attempt marker: it never halted (it was never attempted, or its only attempts are recorded as not started and are re-attempted by the next drive).
- `var ErrNotResumable`: ErrNotResumable is a Resumer's answer for a run it does not drive (another kind, a typed run whose schema is not its type's).
- `var ErrNotStarted`: ErrNotStarted is a run with no run:start record: one never driven (a Signal sent to a mistyped run ID, say), or one whose first drive has not written it yet.
- `var ErrNotifyPermanent`: ErrNotifyPermanent marks a Notifier error as one a retry within the round cannot fix.
- `var ErrRunCancelled = errors.New("run cancelled")`: ErrRunCancelled is the end of a run that was cancelled (see Cancel): the first of the run's end markers in journal order is run:cancelled.
- `var ErrRunEnded = errors.New("run already ended")`: ErrRunEnded is Cancel's answer for a run that is already over: its first end marker is run:complete or run:aborted, so there is nothing left to cancel.
- `var ErrStopRejected`: ErrStopRejected is returned when a record was written but the control run's fold does not accept it (a policy transition raced it, or its signature does not verify under the policy in force at its position): it has no effect.
- `var ErrStopsUnknowable`: ErrStopsUnknowable is returned by StopState.UnknowableErr when a control genuinely cannot judge which stops are in force: a basic process that holds an active stop set under a signed record (it lacks the deployment's policy), or an audited process whose pin the stored chain does not reach, or whose chain forks or competes.
- `var ErrToolNotCalled = errors.New("tool not called")`: ErrToolNotCalled marks a tool call that is known never to have reached its tool, so its side effect cannot have happened.
- `var ErrTrailConflict`: ErrTrailConflict is returned by NotifyTrail.Append when the position is already taken by a different record: another process won the append.
- `var ErrTurnContended`: ErrTurnContended is returned by a Session's Send, SendOnce, Send and SendOnce when another driver holds the lease on the turn's run (see Session): another worker, or, while a cancelled saga turn's rollback is in progress, another caller on the same session handle (see Session.Send).

**Functions**

- `func AbortedKey(runID string) string`: AbortedKey is the event key of runID reaching run:aborted.
- `func Ack(ctx context.Context, d *Journal, runID, channel, key string) error`: Ack marks a message consumed so Receive advances past it.
- `func ApprovalDeadlineStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalDeadlineStep is the journal name of the record that fixes the deadline of the gate on toolUseID (a tool call's ID, or a plan flow node's key).
- `func ApprovalDecisionBytes(s ApprovalSubject, approverID string, approved bool, decidedAt time.Time) []byte`: ApprovalDecisionBytes returns the canonical bytes an approver signs and every verifier checks.
- `func ApprovalDecisionBytesCert(s ApprovalSubject, approverID string, approved bool, decidedAt time.Time, leafHash [32]byte) []byte`: ApprovalDecisionBytesCert returns the canonical bytes a certificate-bound approver signs (bide.approval.v4): the layout of ApprovalDecisionBytes with the domain tag "bide.approval.v4\\n" and, between the verdict byte and the decision time,
- `func ApprovalExecHoldStep(toolUseID string, gen int) string`: ApprovalExecHoldStep is the journal name of the ExecHold record of generation gen of toolUseID's gate.
- `func ApprovalIdentReaskKey(runID, call string, gen int) string`: ApprovalIdentReaskKey is the event key of the approval gate for call on runID asking again for generation gen of a certificate-bound gate: 0 over a plain-name tally it does not act on (PendingIdentReapproval), n &gt;= 1 after an exec hold of generation n-1 (PendingExecHoldReapproval).
- `func ApprovalIdentReaskStep(toolUseID string, gen int) string`: ApprovalIdentReaskStep is the journal name of the pause note a certificate-bound gate writes when it asks again for generation gen: 0 over a plain-name tally it does not act on (PendingIdentReapproval), n &gt;= 1 over the generation n-1 tally that an exec hold superseded (PendingExecHoldReapproval).
- `func ApprovalIdentTallyStep(toolUseID string, gen int) string`: ApprovalIdentTallyStep is the journal name of the terminal tally of an identity-bound gate at generation gen: ApprovalTallyStep plus ":ident" for generation 0 and ":ident-reask:&lt;gen&gt;" for a gate re-asked after an exec hold.
- `func ApprovalIdentityDigestStep(toolUseID string, gen int, digest string) string`: ApprovalIdentityDigestStep is the name of the identity record of generation gen when the plain name already holds a record of a different tally (a crash between the record and the tally, then a different count): the record whose TallyDigest is the one the gate then writes is found under this name, digest being the first 16 hex digits of that digest.
- `func ApprovalIdentityStep(toolUseID string, gen int) string`: ApprovalIdentityStep is the journal name of the ApprovalIdentity record of toolUseID's gate at generation gen.
- `func ApprovalKey(runID, call string, reminder int) string`: ApprovalKey is the event key of the approval gate for call on runID.
- `func ApprovalPauseStep(toolUseID string, n int) string`: ApprovalPauseStep is the journal name of the n-th phase note of the gate on toolUseID (an ApprovalWait with Pause set), n counting from 1 in the order the gate wrote them.
- `func ApprovalPendingStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalPendingStep is the journal name of the record that a run paused at the approval gate of the call toolUseID (see ApprovalWait).
- `func ApprovalReaskKey(runID, call string, sod bool) string`: ApprovalReaskKey is the event key of the approval gate for call on runID asking again over a recorded tally it does not act on (ApprovalPending.Reason): with sod, because its policy now excludes the requester (PendingSoDReapproval); without, because the tally predates DecisionFormat (PendingReapproval).
- `func ApprovalReaskStep(toolUseID string, sod bool) string`: ApprovalReaskStep is the journal name of the pause note a gate writes when it asks again over a recorded tally it does not act on: with sod, a tally that passed without excluding the requester under a policy that now excludes it (its outcome is recorded under ApprovalSoDRetallyStep); without, a tally that passed on decisions predating DecisionFormat (ApprovalRetallyStep).
- `func ApprovalRequestStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalRequestStep is the journal name of the request a plan flow node's approval gate records when the run first reaches it (see ApprovalRequest).
- `func ApprovalRetallyStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalRetallyStep is the journal name of the terminal tally a gate records when it re-asks for approval because the tally under ApprovalTallyStep passed on decisions that predate DecisionFormat (see ApprovalTally.Supersedes).
- `func ApprovalSoDRetallyStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalSoDRetallyStep is the journal name of the terminal tally a gate records when it re-asks for approval because the tally it would otherwise go by passed without excluding the requester, and the gate's policy now excludes it (ApprovalPolicy.ExcludePrincipal: a redeploy added the exclusion, or a drive still running the old policy recorded first).
- `func ApprovalStatusStep(hash string) string`: ApprovalStatusStep is the journal name of the ApprovalStatusBytes record whose DER hashes (SHA-256, lowercase hex) to hash.
- `func ApprovalTallyStep(toolUseID string) string`: ApprovalTallyStep is the journal name of the gate's terminal tally for toolUseID.
- `func Approve(ctx context.Context, d *Journal, runID, toolUseID string, approved bool, opts ...ApproveOption) error`: Approve durably records a human approve/deny decision for a tool call (HITL).
- `func Await[T any](ctx context.Context, name string) (T, error)`: Await blocks the current run until a single-shot signal named `name` is delivered, then returns its payload.
- `func AwaitFor[T any](ctx context.Context, name string, d time.Duration) (T, bool, error)`: AwaitFor blocks the current run until either a single-shot signal named `name` is delivered or the duration d elapses, whichever happens first.
- `func Cancel(ctx context.Context, j *Journal, runID, reason string, opts ...CancelOption) error`: Cancel cancels runID's run (D1), recording reason.
- `func Capability[T any](store Store) (T, bool)`: Capability returns store's implementation of the optional capability T (Lister, Leaser, or any other interface a store may implement beyond Store), looking through wrappers.
- `func CertLeafHash(der []byte) [32]byte`: CertLeafHash is the SHA-256 of a leaf certificate's DER: what a v4 decision signs in place of the certificate itself.
- `func CertRecordVerifies(iv CertIntakeVerifier, s ApprovalSubject, r Record) bool`: CertRecordVerifies reports whether r is a valid decision of a certificate-bound approver for s as the intake judges (CertIntakeVerifier): its chain, identity, scheme and signature hold now and nothing in its chain is revoked.
- `func CheckRedaction(runID, name string, current, tombstone []byte) error`: CheckRedaction checks the part of a redaction that needs no store: that tombstone is a well-formed tombstone (TombstoneLeafHash), that the leaf hash it keeps is the leaf hash of current (LeafHash), and that the record current holds, named name in run runID, is not protected (RedactionProtected).
- `func DecisionStep(d Decision) string`: DecisionStep returns the journal name SubmitDecision gives the record of d first: distinct for each distinct decision (call, approver, verdict, scheme and decision time), and the same for every resubmission of it, whatever its signature bytes, which is why that is a no-op.
- `func DigestKey(bucket string) string`: DigestKey is the event key of the digest for time bucket (an opaque, stable label).
- `func EncodeRecord(r Record) ([]byte, error)`: EncodeRecord returns the journal encoding of r: the bytes a store persists for it and the bytes an audit leaf commits to.
- `func EscalationKey(key string, level int) string`: EscalationKey is the event key of step level (from 1) of the escalation chain of the event with key.
- `func ExecHoldGen(toolUseID, name string) (int, bool)`: ExecHoldGen parses the generation out of name, which must be ApprovalExecHoldStep of toolUseID; ok is false for any other name.
- `func ExpiredKey(runID, call string) string`: ExpiredKey is the event key of the expiry of the approval gate for call on runID (NotificationApprovalExpired).
- `func FormatTimestamp(t time.Time) string`: FormatTimestamp returns t in the one form bide records times in (RunStart.StartedAt, a signed decision's decided\_at, the recorded\_at of a decision and of ApprovalWait): RFC 3339 in UTC, truncated to the millisecond, always 24 bytes and ending in "Z", e.g. "2026-10-13T12:14:03.123Z".
- `func GateReask(t ApprovalTally, excludePrincipal bool) string`: GateReask returns why a gate asks again instead of acting on its recorded tally t, or "": t passed on decisions that predate DecisionFormat (PendingReapproval), or passed without excluding the requester while the policy now excludes it (PendingSoDReapproval).
- `func GateTallyValues(recs []Record, toolUseID string) map[string]Record`: GateTallyValues returns the StepValue records of recs that decide the gate of toolUseID, by name, first writer winning: the plain-name tallies (ApprovalTallyStep, ApprovalRetallyStep, ApprovalSoDRetallyStep), the identity tally chain and the exec holds.
- `func Generate(ctx context.Context, m Model, req Request) (Message, Usage, error)`: Generate is the convenience drain: stream and assemble in one call.
- `func HaltedKey(runID string, kind OpKind, opID string, attemptedMS int64) string`: HaltedKey is the event key of an unknown-outcome halt of the operation opID of kind on runID.
- `func HeldDecisionStep(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, d Decision, verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor) (name string, held, verified bool, err error)`: HeldDecisionStep reports whether the journal holds a record of exactly the decision d (signature included) and the name of the record that does: under the identity name (DecisionStep), under the signature-derived name a bad record at the identity name pushes a decision to, or under the name a version that named by signature gave it.
- `func IdentReaskGen(toolUseID, name string) (int, bool)`: IdentReaskGen parses the generation out of name, which must be ApprovalIdentReaskStep of toolUseID; ok is false for any other name.
- `func IdentTallyGen(toolUseID, name string) (int, bool)`: IdentTallyGen parses the generation out of name, which must be ApprovalIdentTallyStep of toolUseID; ok is false for any other name.
- `func IdentityTier(cc *CertCheck) string`: IdentityTier maps a verifier's finding to the tier the identity record and the approvals intake report: only a final status is a final tier, and the time source says which (an independent source only when the finding names RFC 3161 or an anchor receipt; anything else is the log signer's clock); a live count or a short window is provisional.
- `func Interrupt[T any](ctx context.Context, name string, prompt any) (T, error)`: Interrupt pauses the current run to request typed human input, identified by name.
- `func IsApprovalDecision(r Record, toolUseID string) bool`: IsApprovalDecision reports whether r is an m-of-n approver decision (written by SubmitDecision) on toolUseID.
- `func IsComplete(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, runID string) (bool, error)`: IsComplete reports whether runID completed: its first end marker in journal order is the completion marker the agent loop records at the end of a run (see runCompleteStep).
- `func IsDecisionStepName(name, toolUseID, approverID string) bool`: IsDecisionStepName reports whether name has the shape of the journal record name of a decision of approver on call: the call's approval prefix, the approver, and 64 lowercase hex digits.
- `func IsPause(err error) bool`: IsPause reports whether err, or any error it wraps, is a Pause: the run stopped durably and is waiting, rather than failed.
- `func IsReservedStepName(name string) bool`: IsReservedStepName reports whether name starts with a prefix the engine reserves for its own journal keys.
- `func IsRunPrincipal(r Record) bool`: IsRunPrincipal reports whether r is a run's run:principal record (see RunPrincipal).
- `func IsSessionRun(runID string) bool`: IsSessionRun reports whether runID is a session's journal or one of its turn runs, which the session drives (see Session).
- `func IsSubRun(runID string) bool`: IsSubRun reports whether runID is a sub-agent's run (SubRunID), which its root run drives: its last '&gt;' is followed by an encoded call ID, not by a session's mark.
- `func JournalEntry(name string, rec Record) ([]byte, error)`: JournalEntry returns the bytes a store persists when it records rec as the step named name: rec with Name set to name and a fresh random Salt (see Record.Salt; a salt the engine drew for the record is kept), in its journal encoding (EncodeRecord).
- `func LastSegment(recs []NotifyRecord) string`: LastSegment is the segment named by the last NotifySegment record of an open-trail index, "" if there is none.
- `func LeafHash(recordBytes []byte) []byte`: LeafHash returns the audit leaf hash of a journal record from the bytes the journal stores for it: SHA-256(0x00 || "bide.audit.journal-leaf.v1\\x00" || recordBytes), the RFC 6962 leaf hash of the journal leaf.
- `func Lease(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, runID string, drive func(context.Context) error, opts ...LeaseOption) (bool, error)`: Lease runs drive under an exclusive, auto-renewed lease on runID, so a primary driver and a recoverer (or two workers) do not drive the same run at once.
- `func NewTombstone(name string, recordBytes []byte, at time.Time) ([]byte, error)`: NewTombstone returns the redaction tombstone that replaces the stored bytes recordBytes of the record named name: {"redacted":{"leaf\_hash":"&lt;hex of LeafHash(recordBytes)&gt;","at\_ms":&lt;at in Unix millis&gt;,"name":"&lt;name&gt;"}}.
- `func NextOnceKey(ctx context.Context) string`: NextOnceKey returns a key for the next exactly-once operation (an idempotent append, say) that the tool call running in ctx makes, or "" outside a tool call.
- `func NotifyID(key string) string`: NotifyID is the stable delivery ID of an event: the hex SHA-256 of its key.
- `func NotifyPending(ctx context.Context, j *Journal, n Notifier, trail NotifyTrail, opts ...NotifyOption) error`: NotifyPending runs one catch-up sweep for a notifier: it reads every unfinished run in j and delivers, through n and trail as WithNotifier would, each event that needs a person and has not been delivered: a run waiting at an approval gate, and a run halted on an effect whose outcome is unknown.
- `func NotifyTrailName(runID string) string`: NotifyTrailName is the name of runID's notification trail in a NotifyTrail.
- `func OpenIndex(year int) string`: OpenIndex is the name of the open trail's index for a UTC year: one NotifySegment record per segment created, so the newest segment is found by reading the last record of the newest index (one or two loads, whatever the gaps and the age of the deployment), and the index is the size of a year of days at most.
- `func OpenSegment(t time.Time) string`: OpenSegment is the name of the open-trail segment of the UTC day t is in.
- `func OverdueKey(key string) string`: OverdueKey is the event key of the overdue notice for the event with key.
- `func ParseEscalationKey(key string) (level int, orig string, ok bool)`: ParseEscalationKey splits the key of an escalation step, "escalated:&lt;level&gt;:&lt;key&gt;" (see EscalationKey), into its level (from 1) and the key of the event it escalates.
- `func ParseTimestamp(s string) (time.Time, error)`: ParseTimestamp reads s, which must be in exactly the form FormatTimestamp writes: it parses s and refuses it unless formatting the result again gives s byte for byte.
- `func PromptDigest(msgs []Message) string`: PromptDigest is the hex SHA-256 digest a model record journals of the system prompt a turn was sent: the text of every system message in msgs, in order, each length-prefixed under a domain tag, so no two different prompts share a digest.
- `func Recover(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, resume Resumer, opts ...RecoverOption) (int, error)`: Recover re-drives the runs that were in flight when the process died, in one pass.
- `func RecoverLoop(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, resume Resumer, opts ...RecoverLoopOption) error`: RecoverLoop re-drives in-flight runs until ctx is done, so a run whose holder dies is taken over automatically: Recover is a single pass, and a run another holder leases at that moment is left for a later one.
- `func RecoveryKey(runID string, episode int) string`: RecoveryKey is the event key of runID's episode-th recovery failure (episode counts the recovered records before it, from zero).
- `func RedactURLs(s string) string`: RedactURLs returns s with every URL in it redacted: its userinfo, each query parameter's value, and its fragment become REDACTED, and its scheme, host, path, and query parameter names are kept.
- `func RedactionAncestors(runID string) []string`: RedactionAncestors returns the runs above runID, nearest first, whose records runID's are read with: for a sub-agent's run "a&gt;b&gt;c" they are "a&gt;b" and "a".
- `func RedactionEndMarkers() []string`: RedactionEndMarkers returns the names of the end markers: a run that holds one of them is over, and only such a run may be redacted.
- `func RedactionProtected(name string, kind StepKind) string`: RedactionProtected reports why a record named name, of kind kind, may never be redacted, or "" if it may.
- `func RedactionSession(runID string) bool`: RedactionSession reports whether runID is a session's journal or turn run (agent.IsSessionRun), or a sub-agent run inside one: they are never redacted.
- `func RenderMermaid(ctx context.Context, d *Journal, runID string) (string, error)`: RenderMermaid returns a Mermaid flowchart of a run's journaled steps, the "graph as derived OUTPUT" (Option B): you write plain Go, and the graph is rendered from what actually ran, not hand-authored.
- `func ReportNotifyAck(ctx context.Context, ack NotifyAck)`: ReportNotifyAck is called by a Notifier, with the context it was given, to say how a delivery it is about to acknowledge was authenticated and answered.
- `func ResolveHalt(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, ref HaltRef, out Outcome, opts ...ResolveOption) error`: ResolveHalt is the sanctioned escape from an \*OutcomeUnknown halt.
- `func ResolvedKey(key string) string`: ResolvedKey is the event key of the all-clear for the event with key: the notification that it stopped being current.
- `func RootRunID(runID string) string`: RootRunID returns the run that drives runID: the run itself, or for a sub-agent's run the root run to re-invoke to continue it (ApprovalPending.RootRunID for a gate inside a sub-agent).
- `func SameApprover(a, b string) bool`: SameApprover reports whether two ids name one approver: equal ignoring ASCII case, the rule Validate holds a policy's ids to, and the rule a gate that excludes the requester matches a requester to an approver id by.
- `func SameNotifyRecord(a, b NotifyRecord) bool`: SameNotifyRecord reports whether a and b are the same record: the same canonical JSON, so times compare by instant and not by location or monotonic clock reading.
- `func Sleep(ctx context.Context, name string, d time.Duration) error`: Sleep pauses the current run until d has elapsed from the FIRST time this timer was reached, durably.
- `func SplitToKey(key string) (receiver, base string, ok bool)`: SplitToKey splits the key of a fan-out delivery, "to:&lt;receiver&gt;:&lt;key&gt;" (see ToKey), into the receiver and the key of the event it delivers.
- `func StopDigest(r StopRecord) string`: StopDigest returns the hex SHA-256 of the canonical bytes of the whole record r, signature included: what a lift's SetDigest names.
- `func StopIDOf(r StopRecord) string`: StopIDOf returns the ID of the stop a set record makes: the hex SHA-256 of its canonical bytes without StopID and Signature.
- `func StopPolicyDigest(d StopPolicyDoc) string`: StopPolicyDigest returns the hex SHA-256 of the canonical bytes of a policy document.
- `func StopSigningBytes(r StopRecord) []byte`: StopSigningBytes returns the bytes a signature of r covers: the label, the record's kind and its canonical body (StopID included, Signature excluded).
- `func SubRunID(parent, toolUseID string) string`: SubRunID returns the run ID of the sub-agent run that the call toolUseID of run parent starts: parent, '&gt;', then toolUseID encoded (see encodeID).
- `func SubmitDecision(ctx context.Context, store *Journal, d Decision, opts ...ApproveOption) error`: SubmitDecision records d, one approver's signed decision on an m-of-n gated call.
- `func SupersededTallies(byName map[string]Record, outcome string) []string`: SupersededTallies returns the names of the tallies that outcome, the gate's outcome (as RecordedTally returns it, among byName) supersedes, oldest first: the tally its Supersedes names, and that one's, and so on.
- `func TallyApprovals(recs []Record, s ApprovalSubject, p ApprovalPolicy, verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor) (ApprovalTally, []DecisionCheck)`: TallyApprovals is the m-of-n counting rule, shared by the gate and offline verification so the two cannot drift.
- `func ToKey(receiver, key string) string`: ToKey is the event key of key's delivery to receiver, for an event that goes to several receivers at once (an approval whose approvers are routed to different ones): each has a key, and so an ID, claim and acknowledgement, of its own.
- `func TombstoneLeafHash(b []byte) ([]byte, bool)`: TombstoneLeafHash returns the leaf hash a tombstone keeps, and false if b is not a tombstone in the exact form NewTombstone writes (see isTombstone).
- `func TombstoneMillis(b []byte) (int64, bool)`: TombstoneMillis returns the time a tombstone records, in Unix millis, and false if b is not a tombstone in the exact form NewTombstone writes.
- `func TombstoneName(b []byte) (string, bool)`: TombstoneName returns the record name a tombstone carries, and false if b is not a tombstone or names none (the reserved form allows a tombstone without one).
- `func ToolResultStep(toolUseID string) string`: ToolResultStep is the key of the result of the call toolUseID: the record the loop, a saga rollback, or ResolveHalt writes when the call's outcome is known.
- `func ToolsDigest(tools []ToolSpec) string`: ToolsDigest is the hex SHA-256 digest a model record journals of the tool set a turn was sent: each tool's name, description and argument schema, length-prefixed under a domain tag, in the order of their names, so the digest does not depend on the order the tools were listed in.
- `func ValidReaskNote(byName map[string]Record, toolUseID, name string, w ApprovalWait) bool`: ValidReaskNote reports whether w, the content of the record named name (ApprovalReaskStep of toolUseID), is a re-ask note the journal proves: its Reask is the reason its name stands for, and its Supersedes names a recorded tally (among byName) that GateReask would ask again over for that reason, namely the call's tally for a format re-ask, and for a separation-of-duties re-ask the outcome so far (the format re-approval tally when the tally predates DecisionFormat and that one is recorded, else the tally) under a policy that excludes the requester.
- `func ValidReceiver(name string) bool`: ValidReceiver reports whether name is one a trail may record for a receiver other than the default: what WithNotifyReceiver accepts, and not DefaultReceiver, which a trail records as no name.
- `func ValidateRunID(id string) error`: ValidateRunID reports whether id may name a root run (Run, Resume, Stream, RunTyped): it is not empty and holds no '&gt;', which the engine reserves for the run IDs of sub-agents and session turns.
- `func WaitUntil(ctx context.Context, name string, until time.Time) error`: WaitUntil pauses the current run until the absolute time `until`, durably.

## type APIError

```go
type APIError struct {
	StatusCode int
	Body       string
	Message    string
	Type       string
	Code       string
	Err        error
}
```

APIError is returned by a provider adapter for a non-2xx HTTP response that is not a rate limit (which uses RateLimited), and for an exhausted quota whatever its status (wrapping ErrQuotaExhausted).

**Methods**

- `func (e *APIError) Error() string`: Error describes the failure: the status, the provider's message and error code or type (or the Body when the provider sent no message), then Err.
- `func (e *APIError) Unwrap() error`: Unwrap returns Err, so errors.Is(err, ErrModel) holds when Err wraps ErrModel.

## type Agent

```go
type Agent struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Agent binds a model, a tool set, a durable store, and a middleware chain.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func New(model Model, j *Journal, opts ...Option) (*Agent, error)`: New constructs an Agent over model and the journal j, configured by opts.

**Methods**

- `func (a *Agent) FlushNotifications(ctx context.Context) error`: FlushNotifications waits for the deliveries of a's notifier that are in flight to finish their round, and stops its worker; a later event starts it again.
- `func (a *Agent) Journal() *Journal`: Journal returns the journal the agent writes through: the one New was given.
- `func (a *Agent) Resume(ctx context.Context, runID string, opts ...RunOption) (*Result, error)`: Resume drives runID's run on from its journal: the input, saga flag and options its first drive journaled (see RunStart), and the last limit amendment.
- `func (a *Agent) Run(ctx context.Context, runID string, input Message, opts ...RunOption) (*Result, error)`: Run drives the agent to the end of runID's run, answering input under opts, and returns the run's Result.
- `func (a *Agent) RunTyped[T any](ctx context.Context, runID string, input Message, opts ...RunOption) (T, *Result, error)`: RunTyped runs the agent to the end of runID's run like Run, and returns its answer as a T instead of a free-form Message, with the run's Result (whose Output is the answer as journaled).
- `func (a *Agent) Session(ctx context.Context, id string, opts ...LeaseOption) (*Session, error)`: Session opens (or reopens) a multi-turn conversation with the given id, rebuilding the transcript from the store so a restarted process continues where it left off.
- `func (a *Agent) Stream(ctx context.Context, runID string, input Message, opts ...RunOption) *RunStream`: Stream drives the agent like Run but returns a live RunStream: token deltas, turn boundaries and tool start and finish arrive as events while the durable loop runs, and RunStream.Result returns what Run would.
- `func (a *Agent) With(opts ...Option) (*Agent, error)`: With returns a copy of a configured by opts, applied over a's configuration as New applies them: a setting given here replaces a's, and tools, middleware and retrievals given here are added after a's.

## type AgentRunOption

```go
type AgentRunOption interface {
	Option
	RunOption
}
```

AgentRunOption is a setting that applies to an agent (Option) and to one run (RunOption): WithMaxTurns, WithTokenBudget, WithSystemPrompt, WithSampling, WithToolChoice, WithWaker and WithIdentity.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithIdentity(id Identity) AgentRunOption`: WithIdentity sets the acting identity of a run (see Identity): tool calls read it with IdentityFrom, and the runs they start inherit it.
- `func WithMaxTurns(n int) AgentRunOption`: WithMaxTurns caps the model turns a run may take, so a model that keeps calling tools cannot loop forever.
- `func WithSampling(opts ...SamplingOption) AgentRunOption`: WithSampling sets generation controls applied to every model call (Temperature, TopP, MaxTokens, Stop, Seed).
- `func WithSystemPrompt(s string) AgentRunOption`: WithSystemPrompt sets a system message prepended to the conversation on every model turn.
- `func WithTokenBudget(max int) AgentRunOption`: WithTokenBudget caps the tokens a run, and the runs its tool calls start, may use (see Agent.WithTokenBudget for how the budget is counted and enforced).
- `func WithToolChoice(tc ToolChoice) AgentRunOption`: WithToolChoice sets the tool-choice control applied to every model call (see ToolChoice and Agent.WithToolChoice).
- `func WithWaker(w Waker) AgentRunOption`: WithWaker sets the Waker a run's durable Sleep registers its wake with (see Waker).

## type ApprovalPolicy

```go
type ApprovalPolicy struct {
	Need      int      `json:"need"`
	Approvers []string `json:"approvers,omitempty"`

	ExcludePrincipal bool `json:"exclude_principal,omitempty"`

	Timeout time.Duration `json:"-"`
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

ApprovalPolicy declares a human approval gate.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func SingleApproval() *ApprovalPolicy`: SingleApproval returns the one-decision gate: a call pauses as \*ApprovalPending until Approve records a decision for it.

**Methods**

- `func (p *ApprovalPolicy) Clone() *ApprovalPolicy`: Clone returns a copy of p that shares nothing with it (a SingleApproval stays one), or nil for nil.
- `func (p ApprovalPolicy) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)`: MarshalJSON encodes the policy as the journal records it: SingleApproval as {"single":true}, the bide protocol's wire form of the one-decision gate, so an offline reader sees the gate a call ran under without inferring it from a shape; any other policy as {"need":k,"approvers":`...`}, with "exclude\_principal":true when ExcludePrincipal is set (omitted otherwise, so a policy without it encodes as it did before the field existed).
- `func (p *ApprovalPolicy) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error`: UnmarshalJSON decodes what MarshalJSON encodes, strictly, as the bide protocol writes the gate: {"single":true}, with no other member, is SingleApproval; any other policy has need (and approvers, and optionally exclude\_principal) and no single.
- `func (p ApprovalPolicy) Validate() error`: Validate reports whether the policy is well formed: at least one approver, every approver id non-empty printable ASCII, no two ids the same approver, and 1 &lt;= Need &lt;= len(Approvers).
- `func (p ApprovalPolicy) ValidateKeys(verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor) error`: ValidateKeys reports whether the policy is well formed (Validate) and holds one seat per signing key under verifierFor: it resolves every approver once and refuses, with ErrConfig, a nil verifierFor, an approver whose verifier reports no key identity (an empty KeyIDs, or an empty entry), and two approvers whose verifiers report a common key identity.

## type ApproveOption

```go
type ApproveOption interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

ApproveOption configures SubmitDecision: WithDecisionCheck, WithClock for the clock that stamps the decision's RecordedAt, or ReportWritten.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func ReportWritten(wrote *bool) ApproveOption`: ReportWritten makes SubmitDecision set \*wrote to whether this call stored the decision's record: true when its Insert won the store's first-writer race, false when the journal already held the decision (an identical resubmission, another writer's record under the same name, a concurrent call that wrote it first, in this process or another).
- `func WithDecisionCheck(verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor) ApproveOption`: WithDecisionCheck makes SubmitDecision check the decision before recording it, so an approver learns at submission time that it will not count: it reads the run, finds the call, and verifies the signature against that exact call with verifierFor.

ClockOption is a clock that applies to an agent (Option), to one run (RunOption), to a halt resolution (ResolveOption), to a recorded approver decision (ApproveOption), and to a cancellation (CancelOption), and to an interrupt answer or signal (AnswerOption): WithClock.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithClock(now func() time.Time) ClockOption`: WithClock sets the clock that reads "now": for a run (an agent's runs, or one run), the clock its durable timers (Sleep, WaitUntil, AwaitFor) measure against and that stamps the times it records (RunStart.StartedAt, ApprovalWait.RecordedAt, the end markers' RecordedAt); for ResolveHalt, the one clock of the call: WithMinHaltAge measures against it, and it stamps the claim marker and the outcome's RecordedAt (the context's clock is not read); for SubmitDecision, Approve and Cancel, the clock that stamps the record's RecordedAt.

GateStanding is the result of EvaluateGate.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func EvaluateGate(recs []Record, s ApprovalSubject, pol *ApprovalPolicy, verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor) GateStanding`: EvaluateGate says where the approval gate stands on the call s in runID's journal recs, under the policy pol it is built with now (nil: the tool has no gate) and the approver verifiers, exactly as the agent's own gate reads it: the same function counts for both, so a service that tells approvers whether a call waits cannot disagree with the run.
- `func EvaluateGateAfter(recs []Record, s ApprovalSubject, pol *ApprovalPolicy, verifierFor ApproverVerifierFor, since string) GateStanding`: EvaluateGateAfter is EvaluateGate for a plan flow node's gate (s.ToolUseID a node key), which counts only the decisions recorded after the gate's request, the step ApprovalRequestStep(key) names, and whose result is the key's own record.

## type GateStatus

```go
type GateStatus string
```

GateStatus is where an approval gate stands on one call, as the gate itself reads it.

**Constants**

- `const GateWaiting GateStatus = "waiting"`: GateWaiting: an m-of-n gate with no recorded outcome.
- `const GateDecided GateStatus = "decided"`: GateDecided: the call has an outcome the gate acts on: its result is recorded, or a recorded denial (a human's Approve(false), or an m-of-n tally that did not pass), or the gate's recorded terminal tally that it accepts under the policy now.
- `const GateSingle GateStatus = "single"`: GateSingle: the policy is a one-decision gate (SingleApproval).
- `const GateUngated GateStatus = "ungated"`: GateUngated: no policy now (a redeploy removed the gate): the call runs without approval.
- `const GateMisconfigured GateStatus = "misconfigured"`: GateMisconfigured: the gate would refuse to evaluate, so the run fails at the call rather than pauses: an invalid policy, approvers that share a key, no approver verifiers, a policy that excludes the requester for a run that records none, a tally journaled by something that is not this gate.

## type Journal

```go
type Journal struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Journal is the durable journal the engine writes through: it owns everything a run's records mean on top of a Store.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func NewJournal(s Store, opts ...JournalOption) (*Journal, error)`: NewJournal returns a Journal over s.

**Methods**

- `func (j *Journal) AnswerInterrupt[T any](ctx context.Context, runID, name string, value T, opts ...AnswerOption) error`: AnswerInterrupt records the typed value a paused run is waiting for at the interrupt point name (see Interrupt); then re-invoke Run with the pause's RootRunID to continue.
- `func (j *Journal) Enqueue[T any](ctx context.Context, runID, channel, key string, payload T) error`: Enqueue appends a message to an ordered per-run channel, deduped by key: a redelivery with the same (runID, channel, key) is a no-op and the first payload wins (at-most-once intake over at-least-once transport).
- `func (j *Journal) Format(ctx context.Context, runID string) (string, error)`: Format returns the journal format runID's header names, "" for a run with no entries, and a \*JournalVersionError for a run whose first entry is not a header.
- `func (j *Journal) Get(ctx context.Context, runID, name string) (Record, bool, error)`: Get returns the record named name in runID's journal, if there is one.
- `func (j *Journal) History(ctx context.Context, runID string) ([]Record, error)`: History returns runID's records in journal order, the header first (see Records).
- `func (j *Journal) Parallel[T any](ctx context.Context, runID string, tasks []Task[T], opts ...ParallelOption) ([]T, error)`: Parallel runs tasks concurrently, each as a durable named step (see Step), and returns their results in task order.
- `func (j *Journal) Reanchor(ctx context.Context, runID string) (anchored bool, err error)`: Reanchor asks the journal's store, if it can (a Reanchorer such as audit.AuditedStore), to publish a signed head over runID's journal now, and reports whether it could.
- `func (j *Journal) Records(ctx context.Context, runID string) iter.Seq2[Record, error]`: Records yields runID's records in journal order, the header first.
- `func (j *Journal) Signal[T any](ctx context.Context, runID, name string, payload T, opts ...AnswerOption) error`: Signal delivers a single-shot signal to a run, journaled at-most-once by name: a redelivery (a retried webhook, an at-least-once queue) is a no-op and the first payload wins.
- `func (j *Journal) Step[T any](ctx context.Context, runID, name string, fn func(context.Context) (T, error), opts ...StepOption) (T, error)`: Step runs fn as a named durable step and returns its typed result.
- `func (j *Journal) Store() Store`: Store returns the store the journal writes to.

## type MemWaker

```go
type MemWaker struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

MemWaker is an in-process Waker: it holds pending timers and, when Fire is called with the current time (or via a Start ticker), resumes every run whose timer is due by calling the resume function it was built with.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func NewMemWaker(resume func(ctx context.Context, runID string) error) *MemWaker`: NewMemWaker builds an in-process waker that resumes due runs via resume.

**Methods**

- `func (w *MemWaker) Fire(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) (int, error)`: Fire resumes every run that has a timer due at or before now, each run once even if several of its timers are due, drops the fired timers, and returns how many runs it resumed.
- `func (w *MemWaker) Schedule(_ context.Context, wk Wake) error`: Schedule registers a wake, idempotent per (w.RunID, w.Name): re-scheduling the same timer overwrites its fire time rather than adding a duplicate.
- `func (w *MemWaker) Start(ctx context.Context, every time.Duration, onError func(error)) <-chan struct{}`: Start runs Fire on a ticker every `every` until ctx is cancelled, so sleeping runs wake on their own.

ModelCall is one model call as it passes through the middleware chain.

**Methods**

- `func (c ModelCall) AddHook(h ModelCallHook) ModelCall`: AddHook returns a copy of c with h appended to its hooks, which the agent's model handler runs around every request it sends for the returned call and every call derived from it.
- `func (c ModelCall) Attempt() int`: Attempt is the number of the request a hook is observing.
- `func (c ModelCall) OnAnswer(key any, fn func(ctx context.Context, resp ModelResponse)) bool`: OnAnswer registers fn to run once with the call's answer: the response the whole chain returns to the agent, after the agent's checks, once the journal holds it as the turn's record (for CallModel, which has no journal, once the call returns it).

```go
	ID   string

}
```

Notification is one delivery attempt of an event to a Notifier.

## type NotificationKind

```go
type NotificationKind string
```

NotificationKind says what a Notification is about.

**Constants**

- `const NotificationOutcomeUnknown NotificationKind = "outcome_unknown"`: NotificationOutcomeUnknown: a drive ended with \*OutcomeUnknown.
- `const NotificationApprovalPending NotificationKind = "approval_pending"`: NotificationApprovalPending: a drive ended with \*ApprovalPending.
- `const NotificationRunAborted NotificationKind = "run_aborted"`: NotificationRunAborted: the run reached the run:aborted end marker.
- `const NotificationRecoveryFailing NotificationKind = "recovery_failing"`: NotificationRecoveryFailing: recovery has kept failing for a run for longer than the configured time.
- `const NotificationOverdue NotificationKind = "notification_overdue"`: NotificationOverdue: an event was not acknowledged by its deadline.
- `const NotificationResolved NotificationKind = "resolved"`: NotificationResolved: an outcome\_unknown, approval\_pending or recovery\_failing event that a receiver has, or may have, stopped being current (the halt was resolved, the gate decided, the run ended, recovery recovered).
- `const NotificationApprovalExpired NotificationKind = "approval_expired"`: NotificationApprovalExpired: an approval gate a receiver was, or may have been, told of (approval\_pending) expired: its deadline (ApprovalPolicy.Timeout) passed with no approval, so the call will not run.
- `const NotificationEscalated NotificationKind = "escalated"`: NotificationEscalated: an outcome\_unknown, approval\_pending or recovery\_failing event was not acknowledged (an approval: not decided) by its deadline, and the next receiver of its escalation chain is told.

- `func (e *NotifyEvent) Open() bool`: Open reports whether delivery of the event is still owed: it has been neither acknowledged nor cleared.
- `func (e *NotifyEvent) OverdueDue(now time.Time) bool`: OverdueDue reports whether the event is open, past its deadline at now, and not yet marked overdue.

## type NotifyOption

```go
type NotifyOption interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

NotifyOption configures the notifier WithNotifier and NotifyPending build.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithNotifyAbortedWithin(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyAbortedWithin sets how recent an aborted run must be for NotifyPending to raise its run\_aborted event (default 24 hours), by the time the run started, which is the only time its journal records.
- `func WithNotifyApproverRoute(approver, receiver string) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyApproverRoute sends the approval\_pending event of a gate whose approvers include approver to the named receiver.
- `func WithNotifyClaimTTL(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyClaimTTL sets how long a process's claim on an event lasts (default 2 minutes).
- `func WithNotifyClock(now func() time.Time) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyClock sets the clock the notifier reads: for claim and deadline times, backoff, and the age of an aborted run or a halt in a sweep.
- `func WithNotifyDeadline(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyDeadline sets how long after an event is observed it may go unacknowledged before it is overdue (default 5 minutes).
- `func WithNotifyErrors(fn func(error)) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyErrors sets the function that receives the notifier's own failures: a trail or store error, a delivery that has become failing, a trail position it kept losing.
- `func WithNotifyEscalation(kind NotificationKind, steps ...EscalationStep) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyEscalation sets the escalation chain of events of kind: NotificationOutcomeUnknown, NotificationApprovalPending or NotificationRecoveryFailing.
- `func WithNotifyFailingAfter(n int) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyFailingAfter sets how many failed delivery attempts make a delivery failing (default 8).
- `func WithNotifyHaltAge(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyHaltAge sets how old an attempt marker with no result must be before NotifyPending reports it as a halt (default 5 minutes).
- `func WithNotifyHolder(id string) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyHolder names this process in the claims it writes (default host, pid and a random number).
- `func WithNotifyReceiver(name string, n Notifier) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyReceiver names a receiver besides the one WithNotifier is given (DefaultReceiver), for WithNotifyRoute, WithNotifyApproverRoute and WithNotifyEscalation.
- `func WithNotifyRecoveryFailingAfter(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyRecoveryFailingAfter sets how long recovery must keep failing for a run before a NotificationRecoveryFailing event is raised (default 15 minutes).
- `func WithNotifyRetry(base, max time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyRetry sets the backoff between rounds of a failing delivery: base, doubling per failure, up to max (defaults 1 second and 15 minutes).
- `func WithNotifyRoute(kind NotificationKind, receiver string) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyRoute sends events of kind to the named receiver instead of the default one.
- `func WithNotifyUpgradeWindow(d time.Duration) NotifyOption`: WithNotifyUpgradeWindow sets how long after the first backfill pass the second runs (default 24 hours).
- `func WithOverdueNotifier(n Notifier) NotifyOption`: WithOverdueNotifier sends NotificationOverdue events to n instead of the main Notifier, for the usual case where the main sink being down is why the event is overdue.

## type NotifyRecord

```go
type NotifyRecord struct {
	Kind  NotifyRecordKind `json:"kind"`
	Key   string           `json:"key,omitempty"`
	RunID string           `json:"run_id,omitempty"`
	At    time.Time        `json:"at"`

	ClockAt time.Time `json:"clock_at,omitzero"`

	EventKind string `json:"event_kind,omitempty"`

	Receiver string `json:"receiver,omitempty"`

	Level      int       `json:"level,omitempty"`
	EventAt    time.Time `json:"event_at,omitzero"`
	DeadlineAt time.Time `json:"deadline_at,omitzero"`

	Holder string    `json:"holder,omitempty"`
	Until  time.Time `json:"until,omitzero"`

	FirstSentAt time.Time   `json:"first_sent_at,omitzero"`
	Attempts    int         `json:"attempts,omitempty"`
	Status      int         `json:"status,omitempty"`
	Auth        *NotifyAuth `json:"auth,omitempty"`

	Failures int `json:"failures,omitempty"`

	Latency time.Duration `json:"latency,omitempty"`

	OpRun  string `json:"op_run,omitempty"`
	OpKind string `json:"op_kind,omitempty"`
	OpID   string `json:"op_id,omitempty"`

	Watching   []Watched `json:"watching,omitempty"`
	Backfilled bool      `json:"backfilled,omitempty"`

	Backfills  int       `json:"backfills,omitempty"`
	BackfillAt time.Time `json:"backfill_at,omitzero"`

	BackfillWindow time.Duration `json:"backfill_window,omitempty"`
	Next           string        `json:"next,omitempty"`

	Reason string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
}
```

NotifyRecord is one record of a notification trail.

**Methods**

- `func (r NotifyRecord) Normalized() NotifyRecord`: Normalized returns r with every time in UTC and stripped of its monotonic clock reading, the form a trail stores and compares, so two records of one instant are equal whatever location they were written in.

## type NotifyRecordKind

```go
type NotifyRecordKind string
```

NotifyRecordKind says what a NotifyRecord records.

**Constants**

- `const NotifyObserved NotifyRecordKind = "observed"`: NotifyObserved: a notifier process first saw the event.
- `const NotifyClaimed NotifyRecordKind = "claimed"`: NotifyClaimed: a process claimed the event for one delivery round, until Until.
- `const NotifyAcked NotifyRecordKind = "acked"`: NotifyAcked: the sink acknowledged the event.
- `const NotifyFailing NotifyRecordKind = "failing"`: NotifyFailing: delivery has failed Failures times.
- `const NotifyOverdue NotifyRecordKind = "overdue"`: NotifyOverdue: the event was not acknowledged by its deadline.
- `const NotifyCleared NotifyRecordKind = "cleared"`: NotifyCleared: the event stopped being current (resolved, decided, or the run ended).
- `const NotifyFailingSince NotifyRecordKind = "failing_since"`: NotifyFailingSince: a recovery pass failed and no failure episode was open for the run.
- `const NotifyRecovered NotifyRecordKind = "recovered"`: NotifyRecovered: a recovery pass succeeded while a failure episode was open.
- `const NotifyWatch NotifyRecordKind = "watch"`: NotifyWatch: an event that can stop being current is about to be observed; written to the NotifyOpenTrail, not to a run's trail.
- `const NotifyUnwatch NotifyRecordKind = "unwatch"`: NotifyUnwatch: nothing more is owed for the watched event (its all-clear was acknowledged, or it was cleared before any delivery was attempted, or it was never observed); written to the NotifyOpenTrail.
- `const NotifyCheckpoint NotifyRecordKind = "checkpoint"`: NotifyCheckpoint: the first record of every open-trail segment but the first: the events listed when the previous segment was sealed, carried forward (Watching, Backfilled), so a read starts at the newest segment.
- `const NotifySeal NotifyRecordKind = "seal"`: NotifySeal: the last record of an open-trail segment; Next names the segment that continues it.
- `const NotifySegment NotifyRecordKind = "segment"`: NotifySegment: one record of the open trail's index, naming (Next) a segment that was created.
- `const NotifyBackfilled NotifyRecordKind = "backfilled"`: NotifyBackfilled: the events observed before the open trail existed were listed (once).

## type NotifyRouting

```go
type NotifyRouting struct {
	Routes map[NotificationKind]string `json:"routes,omitempty"`

	ApproverRoutes map[string]string `json:"approver_routes,omitempty"`

	Escalation map[NotificationKind][]string `json:"escalation,omitempty"`
}
```

NotifyRouting is the routing of a notifier: which receiver each kind of event goes to, which receivers an approval goes to by its approvers, and the receivers of each escalation chain.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func RoutingOf(opts ...NotifyOption) (NotifyRouting, error)`: RoutingOf returns the routing the options give a notifier: build it from the same NotifyOptions you pass to WithNotifier or NotifyPending, and write it (as JSON) for the auditor.

**Methods**

- `func (r NotifyRouting) ApproverRouted() bool`: ApproverRouted reports whether routing depends on a gate's approvers, so that a gate's receivers cannot be known without them.
- `func (r NotifyRouting) Receivers(kind NotificationKind, approvers []string) []string`: Receivers returns the receivers an event of kind is delivered to, sorted: for an approval whose approvers are routed, the receiver of each (one delivery each), and, when any approver of the gate has no route, the kind's route as well (else DefaultReceiver), through which that approver is reached; for any other event, or an approval none of whose approvers is routed, the kind's route, else DefaultReceiver.

## type NotifyState

```go
	Keys   []string

}
```

**Constructors and functions**

- `func FoldNotify(recs []NotifyRecord) NotifyState`: FoldNotify folds a trail, in append order, to its state.

**Methods**

- `func (s NotifyState) ByReceiver() map[string][]string`: ByReceiver groups the keys of the events in the trail by the receiver they are to (DefaultReceiver for the default one), each in the order observed: the per-receiver view of a run's deliveries, whose acknowledgement an auditor reads from Events`key`.
- `func (s *NotifyState) RecoveryFailingDue(now time.Time, d time.Duration) bool`: RecoveryFailingDue reports whether the open recovery failure episode has lasted longer than d at now, so a recovery\_failing event is due.

## type Option

```go
type Option interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

Option configures an Agent: New applies options to a new agent, and With to a copy of one.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithApproverVerifiers(fn ApproverVerifierFor) Option`: WithApproverVerifiers sets how the m-of-n approval gate resolves an approver id to the verifier of its decision signatures.
- `func WithMiddleware(mw ...Middleware) Option`: WithMiddleware appends model-call middleware, after any the agent has; the first one added is the outermost.
- `func WithOptions(opts ...Option) Option`: WithOptions groups options into one, applied in order where it appears.
- `func WithRetrieval(r Retriever, k int, opts ...RetrievalOption) Option`: WithRetrieval adds classic retrieval-augmented generation: for each run, the agent retrieves the top-k documents for the run's user message, as a journaled engine step, and adds them to every model request of the run as a user message placed just before that user message (after the system prompt and any earlier turns).
- `func WithSystemPromptFunc(fn func(ctx context.Context, run RunInfo) (string, error)) Option`: WithSystemPromptFunc sets a system message computed for each drive of a run (each Run, Stream or resume), from the run's context and its RunInfo, so it can carry dynamic context (the date, the tenant, state read from elsewhere).
- `func WithToolErrorRedactor(fn func(tool string, err error) string) Option`: WithToolErrorRedactor sets the text recorded for a tool call that fails (see Agent.WithToolErrorRedactor for what it covers).
- `func WithToolMiddleware(mw ...ToolMiddleware) Option`: WithToolMiddleware appends tool-call middleware, after any the agent has; the first one added is the outermost (see ToolMiddleware).
- `func WithTools(tools ...Tool) Option`: WithTools registers tools with the agent.

```go
	ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id,omitempty"`
	Result    json.RawMessage `json:"result,omitempty"`
	IsError   bool            `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
	Approved  bool            `json:"approved,omitempty"`

	*ApproverSignature

	AttemptedAt int64 `json:"attempted_at,omitempty"`

	Reconciled bool `json:"reconciled,omitempty"`

	OutcomeUnknown bool `json:"outcome_unknown,omitempty"`

	Redacted bool `json:"-"`

	Safety   *Safety         `json:"safety,omitempty"`
	Approval *ApprovalPolicy `json:"approval,omitempty"`

	Evidence json.RawMessage `json:"evidence,omitempty"`

	Format string `json:"format,omitempty"`
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Record is one durably-recorded, named event.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func ClaimAttempt(ctx context.Context, j *Journal, runID, name string, rec Record) (won bool, got Record, err error)`: ClaimAttempt writes the attempt marker named name as an exclusive claim and reports whether the caller won it.
- `func DecodeRecord(b []byte) (Record, error)`: DecodeRecord decodes a record from its journal encoding (see EncodeRecord) into an independent copy that shares no memory with b.
- `func DecodeStoredRecord(runID, name string, b []byte) (Record, error)`: DecodeStoredRecord decodes the record a store holds for the step name of run runID (see DecodeRecord) and checks that the record carries that name.
- `func LatestPauseNote(byName map[string]Record, toolUseID string) (r Record, ok bool)`: LatestPauseNote returns the newest pause note on toolUseID among records keyed by name: the separation-of-duties re-ask note (ApprovalReaskStep with sod), else the format re-ask note, else the first pause note (ApprovalPendingStep).
- `func RecordedTally(byName map[string]Record, toolUseID string) (r Record, ok bool)`: RecordedTally returns the record of the gate's outcome on toolUseID among records keyed by name.

**Methods**

- `func (r Record) Approver() string`: Approver returns the approver of a signed decision (ApproverSignature.Approver), or "" when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) ApproverAlg() Alg`: ApproverAlg returns the scheme a signed decision is under (ApproverSignature.ApproverAlg), or "" when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) ApproverCert() [][]byte`: ApproverCert returns the certificate chain a certificate-bound decision carries (ApproverSignature.ApproverCert), leaf first, or nil when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) ClaimID() string`: ClaimID returns the random id of the driver that wrote this attempt marker or not-started record (see ClaimAttempt), or "" for any other record.
- `func (r Record) DecidedAt() string`: DecidedAt returns the signed decision time of a signed decision (ApproverSignature.DecidedAt), or "" when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) Finish() FinishReason`: Finish returns why the model turn ended (ModelTurn.Finish), or "" when the record carries no model-turn metadata.
- `func (r Record) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)`: MarshalJSON returns the record's JSON encoding, claim and salt included, without HTML escaping (see EncodeRecord for the canonical form a store persists).
- `func (r Record) Model() *ModelInfo`: Model returns the model that answered the turn (ModelTurn.Model), or nil when the record carries no model-turn metadata.
- `func (r Record) PromptDigest() string`: PromptDigest returns the digest of the system prompt the turn was sent (ModelTurn.PromptDigest), or "" when the record carries no model-turn metadata.
- `func (r Record) Raw() []byte`: Raw returns the bytes the store holds for the record, verbatim, for a record read back from a journal (Journal.Get, Journal.History, or Journal.Records).
- `func (r Record) RawFinish() string`: RawFinish returns the provider's own finish reason (ModelTurn.RawFinish), or "" when the record carries no model-turn metadata.
- `func (r Record) RecordedAt() string`: RecordedAt returns when a signed decision was journaled (ApproverSignature.RecordedAt), or "" when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) Salt() []byte`: Salt returns the record's salt: SaltSize random bytes the journal sets when it first records the record (see JournalEntry), replacing any salt the step returned (the engine draws the salt of its own model records itself, just as randomly, to tell its record from another writer's).
- `func (r Record) Signature() []byte`: Signature returns the signature of a signed decision (ApproverSignature.Signature), or nil when the record carries none.
- `func (r Record) ToolsDigest() string`: ToolsDigest returns the digest of the tool set the turn was sent (ModelTurn.ToolsDigest), or "" when the record carries no model-turn metadata.
- `func (r *Record) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error`: UnmarshalJSON decodes a record from its JSON encoding, claim and salt included.

## type ResolveOption

```go
type ResolveOption interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

ResolveOption configures ResolveHalt.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithEvidence(v any) ResolveOption`: WithEvidence records the resolution as reconciled from verified evidence rather than an operator's bare assertion: it marks the injected result Reconciled and stores v (JSON-marshalled) as its Evidence, signed alongside the outcome.
- `func WithMinHaltAge(d time.Duration) ResolveOption`: WithMinHaltAge refuses to resolve a halt younger than d, measured from the live attempt marker's AttemptedAt to now (an attempt recorded as never started does not count).
- `func WithoutLiveDriverCheck() ResolveOption`: WithoutLiveDriverCheck skips ResolveHalt's check that no driver may still be running the halted operation: the lease probe on a store that leases runs, and the WithMinHaltAge requirement on one that does not.

## type Resumer

```go

```

Resumer drives one run a recovery pass found unfinished: runID, started as start (its run:start, read under the run's lease).

**Constructors and functions**

- `func ResumeAgent(a *Agent, opts ...RunOption) Resumer`: ResumeAgent returns the Resumer that drives a's runs: those of kind agent that are not typed, sagas included (the run's journal says which).
- `func ResumeAny(rs ...Resumer) Resumer`: ResumeAny returns the Resumer that hands a run to each of rs in turn, in order, until one returns anything that does not wrap ErrNotResumable (nil included), and returns that.
- `func ResumeTyped[T any](a *Agent, opts ...RunOption) Resumer`: ResumeTyped returns the Resumer that drives a's typed runs whose answer type is T: the runs of kind agent whose run:start journals T's schema digest, in their journaled output mode.

## type RunOption

```go
type RunOption interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

RunOption configures one run (Run, Resume, Stream, RunTyped, Session.Send).

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithOutputMode(m OutputMode) RunOption`: WithOutputMode sets how a typed run (RunTyped) collects its answer: OutputTool (the default) or OutputNative (see OutputMode).
- `func WithSaga() RunOption`: WithSaga runs the run as a saga: a step that fails after earlier writes succeeded rolls the run back, compensating the completed writes in reverse order (recursing into sub-agent trees), and the run returns \*SagaAborted.
- `func WithToolFilter(names ...string) RunOption`: WithToolFilter restricts a run to the named tools of its agent: the model is offered only those, and a call naming any other tool (a model naming a tool it was not offered, or a turn replayed from the journal) is refused at dispatch, with an error result recorded that the model reads, and the tool never runs.

- `func (p RunPrincipal) Requesters() []string`: Requesters is every requester p names: the OnBehalfOf of each ancestor, root first, then the run's own.

## type StepKind

```go

```

**Constants**

- `const StepModel StepKind = "model"`: StepModel records an assistant message from the model.
- `const StepToolResult StepKind = "tool_result"`: StepToolResult records a completed tool call and its result.
- `const StepValue StepKind = "value"`: StepValue records the result of a user-authored durable step (see Journal.Step).
- `const StepSignal StepKind = "signal"`: StepSignal records an external event delivered into a run (see Journal.Signal and Await).
- `const StepApproval StepKind = "approval"`: StepApproval records a durable human decision to approve or deny a tool call.
- `const StepAttempt StepKind = "attempt"`: StepAttempt is the marker a driver claims exclusively before a non-retriable side effect.

- `const StepHeader StepKind = "header"`: StepHeader is the journal header: the first record of every run's journal, named "@journal", whose Format names the journal format the run is written in (see JournalFormat).
